clue.text: A bogus journalist felt humiliated

parts.note: something bogus is a sham, a fake
ED, short for editor, is the crossword's stock journalist

explanation.surface: A fraudulent reporter is left feeling disgraced after being found out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'felt' is a link word here, joining the wordplay to the definition 'humiliated'.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling humiliated and feeling shame describe the same mortified state.

clue.text: Received a hero's treatment when landed

indicators.note: letters that have received treatment have been worked over, so the phrase a hero's gets rearranged
a treatment is a handling or reworking, telling us to rearrange the letters of the phrase a hero's

parts.note: the S of the possessive counts here as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: A returning warrior is fêted the moment he steps off the boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Received ... treatment' asks for the letters of A HERO'S, including the S, to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has landed has come off a ship onto dry land, on the shore.

clue.text: It's paid respectfully

parts.note: reads like money handed over politely, but it is the tribute one pays, as in the idiom of paying respects

explanation.definitionFit: Tribute or honour is something one 'pays' to a person, a set idiom.

clue.text: Operatic lady happy to be left on her own?

parts.note: merry means happy and cheerful
a widow is a woman left alone by her husband's death

explanation.surface: A soprano role for a woman content to be alone.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lehár operetta's title character; 'to be' links the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanna Glawari, heroine of Lehár's operetta, is the title character, a wealthy widow.

clue.text: Exhaust pipe

definitions.meaning: to exhaust is to use up or sap completely
a pipe or channel that carries away waste water

explanation.definitionFit: To deplete resources is to empty them out, and a conduit carrying off waste water is the noun sense.

clue.text: An instrument of Eve's downfall

parts.note: the tempter in Eden who brought about Eve's fall, and also an old bass wind instrument

explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis the snake tempted Eve; the same name belongs to a curved Renaissance bass horn.

clue.text: Car ban for those seeking a drink

parts.note: a saloon is a car with a closed body and separate boot
to bar is to ban

explanation.surface: A motoring prohibition aimed at people heading out for a pint.
explanation.walkthrough: A saloon bar is the more comfortable lounge of a British pub; a saloon is the British name for a sedan car.
explanation.definitionFit: The lounge of a British pub is a place where drinkers go to be served.

clue.text: Natural reaction of garages running out of gas

indicators.note: running out of something means having none left, so the letters of gas leave the word garages

explanation.surface: A garage that has no fuel left provokes understandable fury.
explanation.walkthrough: G, A and S come out of GARAGES one at a time, in order, leaving R, A, G, E.
explanation.definitionFit: Fury is an instinctive, unthinking response to frustration.

clue.text: One sort of examiner always circles a wrong mark

indicators.note: circles means goes round, so the word for always surrounds the mark

parts.note: eternal means lasting always
a cross, X, is the mark put by a wrong answer

explanation.surface: An examiner perpetually rings an incorrect cross on a script.
explanation.walkthrough: 'circles' puts X inside ETERNAL after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Universities appoint an outside assessor from another institution to check their exam marking.

clue.text: Amount of business that's produced by patisserie?

definitions.meaning: the total sales a firm takes in over a period
a pastry folded over a fruit filling, as made by a pastry shop

explanation.definitionFit: A company's revenue figure and a folded fruit pastry, such as an apple one, share the name.

clue.text: Poet's house by the sea in France

parts.note: mer is the French word for sea

explanation.surface: A writer's holiday home on the French coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poet's' is read as 'Poet is'; 'by' simply places one piece beside the other.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek author of the Iliad and the Odyssey is the archetypal epic bard.

clue.text: Reptile snarling at gorilla

indicators.note: snarling suggests tangled or knotted, so the letters of at gorilla are rearranged

explanation.surface: A crocodilian beast growls at an ape.
explanation.definitionFit: The broad-snouted American crocodilian is a large scaly reptile.

clue.text: Game for an old school get-together

parts.note: Rugby School is a famous old English public school, where the game was born
a union is a coming together

explanation.surface: Former pupils meeting up at a reunion.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby is the English town and public school whose name the sport took; 'for an' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifteen-a-side football code is a team sport.

clue.text: Golden retriever's craft

parts.note: looks like a dog breed, but means the vessel of the man who went to fetch the Golden Fleece

explanation.definitionFit: Jason sailed this ship in his quest to bring back the Golden Fleece in Greek myth.

clue.text: Mimi's was frozen, let's face it

definitions.text: Mimi's was frozen, let's face it

parts.words: Mimi's was frozen, let's face it
parts.note: in La Bohème Rodolfo sings that Mimi's tiny hand is frozen; a clock's face carries a pointer of the same name

explanation.definitionFit: A tiny hand, as in Rodolfo's aria, and the long pointer on a clock face counting the minutes.

clue.text: Its members showed bravery when put in charge

definitions.text: Its members showed bravery when put in charge

parts.words: Its members showed bravery when put in charge
parts.note: 'in charge' sounds like being in command, but refers to the cavalry charge at Balaclava immortalised by Tennyson

explanation.definitionFit: The British cavalry unit made the doomed charge in 1854 during the Crimean War.

clue.text: Having a symptom of fever — rash?

definitions.meaning: feverish, with a high temperature in the skull

explanation.definitionFit: A fevered brow is literally burning, and an impetuous person acts without stopping to think.

clue.text: A gem you can safely handle

definitions.text: A gem you can safely handle

parts.words: A gem you can safely handle
parts.note: slang for a diamond, and also the hand-held firework that is safe to hold

explanation.definitionFit: Slang calls a diamond by this name, and a firework on a stick held in the hand shares it.

clue.text: Safe vessel, one showing no sign of age

definitions.text: one showing no sign of age

parts.note: peter is old criminal slang for a safe
a pan is a cooking vessel

explanation.surface: A strongbox and a container, and someone who looks forever young.
explanation.walkthrough: PETER for a safe is old underworld slang, found in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: J. M. Barrie's character is the boy who never grows up.

clue.text: Report spouse being silly and unreasonable

indicators.note: being silly suggests acting in a wild, disordered way, so the letters of report spouse are rearranged

explanation.surface: A complaint that one's husband or wife is acting foolishly and irrationally.
explanation.definitionFit: Something absurd and contrary to sense is utterly irrational.

clue.text: Sayings of modern times

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks the modern era of the calendar
ages are periods of time

explanation.surface: Proverbs that belong to the present day.
explanation.definitionFit: Proverbs and maxims are old sayings.

clue.text: Vegetables with holes in them

definitions.meaning: leafy green vegetables such as cabbage
the putting surfaces on a golf course each have a hole

explanation.definitionFit: Leafy cabbage-type produce, and the putting areas of a golf course, each with its cup.

clue.text: Dance and swim

definitions.meaning: as when one's head swims, to whirl or stagger dizzily

explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish country dance, and to stagger with giddiness as the head spins.

clue.text: Soldiers in irregular wars need someone to provide intelligence

indicators.note: the soldiers are placed in the rearranged letters
irregular means out of order, so the letters of wars need are rearranged

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a stock abbreviation for soldiers

explanation.surface: Troops fighting in guerrilla conflicts need someone to supply them with information.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irregular' turns WARS NEED into NEWSADER, and 'in' puts RE inside it after NEWS.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadcaster who reads out the news supplies the public with information.

clue.text: Rock singer about to be detected in depravity

indicators.note: something detected in a word is found inside it, so the word for about sits within the word for depravity

parts.note: sin is moral wickedness
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A rock star is about to be caught out in wickedness.
explanation.walkthrough: In Greek myth the singers on rocks lured sailors to their deaths with song.
explanation.definitionFit: These mythical women sang from their rocky island to lure sailors onto the reefs.

clue.text: Water source thoroughly

definitions.meaning: a shaft sunk to draw up water
done thoroughly, as in 'mixed together properly'

explanation.definitionFit: A shaft dug to reach ground water, and an adverb meaning properly or fully.

clue.text: He sees what others have to say

definitions.text: He sees what others have to say

parts.words: He sees what others have to say
parts.note: most people hear speech, but this person watches it, reading the movement of the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: A deaf person who understands speech by watching the mouth's movements.

clue.text: Dispute right to enter complaint

indicators.note: to enter is to go into, so the letter for right goes inside the complaint

parts.note: ague is a feverish complaint, an illness

explanation.surface: Contesting the right to lodge a grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' means an illness here, not a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarrel or contend about something is to row over it.

clue.text: Was the first to go after a row became embittered

indicators.note: after means placed after, so the leading word follows the row

parts.note: a rank is a row, as of soldiers or taxis
led means was in front, came first

explanation.surface: Someone who led the way after a quarrel turned bitter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' rhymes with 'go' here, a line rather than a quarrel; 'to go' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A grievance that festered left lasting resentment.

clue.text: It sounds bad lacking love — but they're in the pink!

indicators.note: bad means corrupted, so the letters of it sounds are rearranged once the love is gone

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A tune that sounds awful without love, yet the people concerned are in fine fettle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacking' takes O out of IT SOUNDS, and 'bad' rearranges the remaining letters. 'In the pink' usually means healthy; here it means showing bare pink skin.
explanation.definitionFit: Naturists wear no clothes, so they show only bare skin.
